newsitem.title: USA: Falcon sees potential in lodging market.
newsitem.headline: Falcon sees potential in lodging market.

text.p: Falcon Products Inc, which makes products for the hospitality, foodservice and office furniture industries, on Monday said it saw significant growth opportunities in the lodging market.

"Falcon's strategic plan identified the lodging market as an area with significant growth opportunities," Chairman Franklin Jacobs said in a statement. "We are pleased to report that demand in the lodging market in the first quarter exceeded our expectations and the goals set in our plan."

Jacobs said strong customer orders for lodging products prompted the company to double its manufacturing space in Tijuana, Mexico, during the fiscal first quarter. Falcon also began a capital spending program to more than triple capacity of that facility.
Earlier, Falcon said earnings for the quarter ended February 1 rose to $0.19 per share from $0.17 in the comparable period the previous year.
Falcon also said it purchased about 135,000 shares of its common stock for a total cost of about $2.0 million under a previously authorized share buyback program.
